description: Original service-independent deterministic civilization base-game orchestration, generated fair starting-site deployment, actor turns, city economy, worker orders, research, policies, diplomacy, trade, AI, four victory conditions with a configurable escalating culture race, loser-owned loss events, deterministic combat with percentage terrain/fortification defence, wounded defenders and flanking, healing by location, fog-safe combat previews, Civ V-style movement (partial moves, a same-enemy zone of control from visible enemies at war, one-third road steps in exact sixths) with fog-safe move previews, Civ V-flavoured experience and promotions (Drill, Shock, Cover, Accuracy and Medic lines, PromoteUnit, medic healing, AI choice and fog-safe unit fields), Civ V-flavoured city combat (once-per-round CityRangedStrike from city strength with population, era, Walls and garrison terms, exact fog-safe strike previews, a Catapult siege bonus against cities and deterministic AI strikes), Civ V-flavoured terrain features (Forest, Jungle, Marsh, Oasis: yields, movement, defence, roughness and allowed improvements) and rivers along tile edges (gold, fresh-water Farms, river crossings that end movement unless bridged by roads, a melee attack penalty) with exact previews and fog-safe projection, Civ V-flavoured world wonders (eight once-per-world wonders with city and empire effects that follow the holding city, lost races that keep their production, fog-safe public WonderBuilt news and wonder list, deterministic AI races) and golden ages (a happiness meter with a growing, pace-scaled threshold, gold and production bonuses, wonder-started and extended ages, private events), Civ V-flavoured barbarians-lite (a non-playing hostile faction under owner id 0 that every civilization is always hostile to, deterministic seed-and-round encampments on unseen land under map-size caps with pace and difficulty scaling, era-tier raiders, a simple terminating guard/hunt/wander AI that damages but never captures cities, camp clearing with a gold reward and fog-safe camp projection, a barbarian experience cap, AI camp clearing and defence, and a match option), Civ V-flavoured content breadth (forty technologies in six eras with a technology-defined era, thirty units with separate attack, defence and ranged values, role bonuses and upgrade paths, twenty-five buildings, strategic resource quantities derived from improved tiles and living units with shortage messages and own-only stock reporting, upgrade fields, and a deterministic AI that builds for need, era and upkeep, builds a Colosseum only when its cities need contentment, mixes its army and upgrades, and a culture race paced to the longer tree by a pace-scaled default policy cost growth), final score reveal with coarse public progress and fog-safe projections. Uses separately attributed HexMath through WorldMap. Synthetic balance and original gameplay code, no copied upstream ruleset/media, no claim of complete Unciv parity.
